Long winters spent sagging

White Mountains, Arizona

Silent Sentinels

Long winters spent sagging

Watching us live out our fleeting lives

Reaching for warmer hopes

And breathing new life all the while.

I’ll stick to greens (for now)

Long rasping calls, puncuated by brief  “   ”

Then start over, once again, and repeat  “   ”

Practiced patience makes perfect, but

I’ll stick to greens (for now)

The Phoenician on the Phoenician

23 years in the making

Revisiting a moment well-known

And oft-overlooked

Double Diamonds (Suicide)

Dizzying depths dropping off on each side

Twice an excellent status, when personified

Darker than death, and classified as

Double Diamonds (Suicide)
